name: Santa Clara City Library Teen Volunteers
org: Santa Clara City Library (City of Santa Clara)
what_you_do: Keep the library neat, help set up and run programs and events, or write book reviews from home. Homework Club Coaches help kids in grades 2-8 with homework.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 14 and in high school.
duration: At least 20 hours. Homework Club Coach is a 6-month commitment (fall or spring semester).
deadline_text: The library takes teen volunteers year-round, with limited spots. Homework Club Coach spots are full for Fall 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill out the teen volunteer form linked at the bottom of the page. Fill in every box that is required, or your form will not count. You must finish the new helper steps before you start. Ask Karen Guzman: kguzman@santaclaraca.gov.
notes: This is the city's own library (Central Park, Northside and Mission), not the county library. Each book review counts as one hour. The library's adult reading tutor program is for ages 18 and up.
